items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday after limited practice and high-ankle diagnosis; third straight miss.
items.implication: Huntley start lowers Ravens pass-catcher ceilings especially Andrews; Zay Flowers still viable but lower floor.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT for MNF vs DAL. Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play (hamstring return).
items.why: Eagles Saturday report; Smith ruled out, Saquon expected.
items.implication: Goedert/Wicks (also out notes) elevate; Saquon RB1 if active vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Smith absence boosts Goedert target share in plus matchup.

items.text: Key OUTs: Mike Evans/Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson. INs: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison/TJ Hockenson, etc. Q: Lamar/Puka/Breece/Baker/etc.
items.why: Sunday early injury dump with statuses.
items.implication: Multiple handcuff/backup elevations; Charbonnet out boosts Walker; Monty out opens Houston RB; Warren out hits Colts TE.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries clear on each OUT (e.g. Bijan, Kittle, Walker, Judkins).

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: Tyler Higbee lead, then Konata Mumpfield, Colby Parkinson, Tutu Atwell, Jordan Whittington, Davis Allen. Nacua GTD after limited/no practice Fri, will test pregame.
items.why: Calf felt power/explosion loss mid-practice Thu; McVay confirmed pregame test. Adams already long-term out.
items.implication: Puka still start if active; if OUT, Higbee becomes TE1 priority and Rams WRs elevate for volume.
items.opportunity: TE target share spiked to 37% in prior Puka absences; Adams out amplifies funnel.

items.text: Tank Dell activated (first action ~2 years), Christian Kirk activated for 49ers debut, Jordan Mason activated/expected for Vikings.
items.implication: Dell/Kirk add WR depth/competition; Mason RB committee factor for Vikings.
items.opportunity: Monitor snap shares on returns; Kirk helps 49ers WR vacuum slightly.

items.text: Packers activated Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at DET. Backups Lloyd/Johnson poor EPA/rush.
items.implication: Jacobs reclaims lead back role; start if volume confirmed.

items.text: Saquon if active vs DAL goes right back in lineups (agrees with Stephania). Breece Hall if plays vs MIA also back in starters despite some rust concern.
items.why: Returns from hamstring/quad; matchups favorable enough to force start if cleared.
items.implication: Must-start RB1s if active; monitor final reports.

items.text: Colston Loveland LOVE/BACK: since Caleb return, 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yds both games.
items.why: Caleb chemistry unlocked elite TE usage/production.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love). Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson vs SF.
items.why: Hamstring ruled out; Bijan gets bellcow with no BRob.
items.implication: Bijan elite RB1 with volume + favorable DvP.
items.opportunity: Full carries + pass-game upside vs leaky SF run/pass D to RBs.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT. Kittle will go nuts (scheme + WR corps decimated). CMC tempted for more slot work amid WR injuries (rare buy of RB-as-WR talk given Kaelon Black presence).
items.why: Shanahan confirmed Evans Achilles/ribs out; Deebo hamstring out. CMC smiled at slot question.
items.implication: Kittle massive TE1 upgrade; CMC receiving upside spike possible.
items.opportunity: WR vacuum funnels targets to Kittle/CMC; Christian Kirk activated for debut.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson downgrade: only 21% snaps last three weeks. Not like this.
items.implication: Sit/flex demotion; handcuff or drop risk in shallow.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes. Kmet IR may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Efficiency elite; teammate IR opens routes.
items.opportunity: Route rate boost + YPRR = target/yardage upside.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren (special game, Steelers have something), Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving for big workloads in friendly matchups.
A.J. Brown LOVE/BUY: Week 6 33% TS, 97% routes despite 3 catches/3 drops/27 yds on 10 targets. Usage elite.
items.why: Route/target dominance persists; buying the inefficiency as temporary.
